requirements: R1: Implement server endpoint /api/chat accepting user queries, performing semantic context retrieval against the 1,697 normative documents catalog, and returning grounded answers with cited document references
R2: Integrate the /api/chat endpoint with the web frontend interface supporting prompt dispatch, streaming or instant response display, and document citation inspection

R3: Build comprehensive Playwright E2E verification covering physical clickability and reactive state transitions of all interactive buttons across the web interface including category/specialty filters, clipboard path copying, and query submission to the regulatory assistant

slices.title: Define OpenAPI contract for /api/chat endpoint and regulatory retrieval responses
slices.jtbd: When implementing shared communication contracts for this epic, I want a formal OpenAPI specification for /api/chat request and response payloads, so that backend generation and frontend chat UI can develop against an invariant contract.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the OpenAPI specification in docs/contracts/Internal.openapi.yaml, When inspecting the schema for /api/chat, Then request body defines query string, optional filters, and history context, and response schema defines answer text, matched documents with titles and paths, and response latency.
Given client validation rules, When a query without required text is submitted, Then the contract specifies a 422 Unprocessable Entity error schema.

slices.title: Implement /api/chat backend endpoint with semantic retrieval over 1,697 normative documents
slices.jtbd: When implementing backend AI assistant capabilities for this epic, I want a fast FastAPI route /api/chat querying the NormativeInvertedIndex and generating grounded regulatory answers, so that staff and residents receive legally accurate normative guidance with source citations.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a POST request to /api/chat with query 'регламент ГИА 3 этапа', When the route executes, Then the server retrieves relevant normative documents from the 1,697 catalog in sub-50ms and returns a structured response containing grounded guidance and citation paths.
Given an empty or whitespace-only query, When submitted to /api/chat, Then the endpoint returns status code 400 or 422 with an explicit Russian-language error message without raising an unhandled exception.

slices.title: Implement interactive assistant chat UI and button click handlers in frontend
slices.jtbd: When implementing the web assistant client for this epic, I want an accessible interactive chat component connecting to /api/chat with clickable filter chips, clipboard path copy, and clear keyboard focus states, so that desktop and mobile users can submit queries and inspect sources comfortably.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the assistant web view on desktop or mobile, When the user types an inquiry and clicks the submit button or presses Enter, Then an active loading indicator appears, followed by the rendered assistant response with source document chips.
Given a search result or citation item, When the user clicks the copy path button, Then the relative document path is written to the navigator clipboard and visible visual feedback ('Скопировано') appears for 2 seconds.

slices.title: E2E Playwright verification suite for physical button clickability and assistant flow
slices.jtbd: When verifying interface reliability and delivery readiness for this epic, I want an end-to-end Playwright test suite asserting physical clickability and functionality of all interactive UI controls, so that regression-free verification in main satisfies the D008 release gate.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the running web client in a Playwright browser session, When the test suite iterates across all rendered category/specialty filter buttons, copy buttons, and assistant submit controls, Then every control receives click events without obstruction, timeout, or console errors.
Given an inquiry sent via the assistant UI in Playwright, When /api/chat responds, Then the response container is populated and verified visible on both desktop (1280x800) and mobile (375x667) viewports.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% test pass rate across all browser viewports
